Substations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the major maintenance procedure P1, to be performed 
every ten years Y10 as indicated in the above title block.
The first draft initiated by 
Eng. Ayman Mahmoud Awad, tested at 17 April 2002 by eng Emad Farouq Mostafa at Katamia Substation, Cairo
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category,
Ensure that the CB isolated completely and proper 
 grounded on both sides,
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area,
Wear your safety 
 Helmet.
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category,
Ensure that the CB isolated completely and proper 
 grounded on both sides,
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area,
Wear your safety 
 Helmet.
Isolate the DC
 control voltage, the door of the local CB must be opened.
Tools and Equipment
1 set of fitter's tools, 1 
 torque wrench, 
 and some of clean and dry cloth,
1 industrial vacuum cleaner, 
 special tools, and lifting gear (fork lift).
Exhaust tube - operating rod, 1 
 socket spanner - locking tool
Works to be Carried Out
Clean the breaker pole within one hour of opening
 gas compartmemt
Switch off the campressor motor and remove electrical
 connection
Vent compressed air opening drain valve
Remove SF6 gas
Remove breaker
 pole releasing the mechanical connection to the base frame and dissonnect
 coupling link from bolis
Remove push and pull rod
With draw the breaker from its cell
Push the breaker into the maintenance room
Remove the air receiver tank
Unscrew the air pipe
Unscrew SF6 gas pipe
Undo nexagonal head 
 screw 2705 and remove with washers fig 1
Draw out bolt 2704 with the inside treade M8 off
 the lever 2703
Attach crame rope and s-hook to lifting eye on cover fixed
 contect and raise crane rope slightly
Undo hexagonal head screw 0118 fig. 
 1 and lift breaker pole
Remove the pneumatic drive
Remove the center breaker pole
Dismantling the breaker pole
Before dismantling plug contacts their position should be marked
Remove the insulating shell
Remove plug contacts
Undo socket part 
 2500 fig 2
Unscrew chees head screws and remove socket part 2500 from
 guide flange
Using the vacuum cleaner remove any dust 
 produced by
 switching which may be present in the socket part 2500
Remove fixed contact 
 fig 3
Attach crane rope and shook to lifting eye on cover 1107 and
 raise crane rope slightly
Undo chees head 
 screws 0102 and carefully lift extinction chamber insulator 1001 with fixed 
 contact out of insulator column 2000 and set vertically on one side fig 4
Undo cheese head screw 0101 and taxe fixed contact 1100 out
 of extinction chamber insulator
Remove moving contact

 ring nozzle 1211 - multicontact 1215 - Auxiliary nozzle 1223 bearing 2511

 insulator - operating system)
